name: Mango lassi
description: Yogurt blended with mango pulp and sugar — thick, sweet and everywhere on a curry-house menu.

ayurveda.note: Dahi is ushna at high confidence, but ripe mango's own virya is itself contested between schools — the drink is read heating, whatever its temperature, but not asserted at high confidence.

unani.note: Aam is garam; the dahi is thanda, so desi readings split on it.

histamine.note: Low, though it is yogurt plus fruit and does not keep.

effects.note: Mango lassi is yogurt itself, blended with mango and sugar, carrying the same live cultures credited with yogurt's own lactose-digestion effect — untested directly, but not a different food from the yogurt the trials used, just a fruited, thicker serving of it. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
